notes: England only (Scotland and Wales are separate queue lines). RCVS Find a Vet: the findavet.rcvs.org.uk page redirects to rcvs.org.uk and could not be fetched (not in the allowed fetch set); the RCVS 'practice data conditions of supply' page says RCVS practice data is supplied to third parties only under conditions, so no RCVS data was used - clinics' own pages only. NO DUTY ROTA found: England has no official duty-rota page (RCVS requires each practice to provide 24-hour emergency cover itself); none added. POISON LINE: Animal PoisonLine 01202 509000 is a paid service (GBP 35 / 45 per case). Unreachable or skipped: findavet.rcvs.org.uk, Scarsdale/Pride Veterinary Centre Derby (scarsdalevets.com redirects to ivc.co.uk, not fetchable), Medivet 24 Hour Chorley and Dearne Valley (page not fetchable), Medivet Birstall (page says permanently closed), University of Liverpool Small Animal Teaching Hospital (contact page has address +44 151 795 6100 but no 24 h statement), University of Surrey and Nottingham vet school small-animal hospitals (no pages with emergency hours reached), Davies Veterinary Specialists (page did not state 24 h), Dick White Referrals (phone 01638 572012 and 'we take emergencies 24/7' seen but no address on pages opened), Blue Cross Hammersmith (no hours; 0300 777 1890), Vets Now Glasgow (Scotland). Aggregator vetsinsheffield.com not used. LEFT: independent 24-h hospitals in Leeds, Newcastle, Sheffield, Norwich, Brighton, Southampton, Nottingham, Cornwall/Devon, Lake District, Peak District, Cotswolds; Vets Now ~50 further out-of-hours clinics (finder lists 62, only 12 visible); Eastcott Swindon, Chestergates Chester, Paragon Wakefield, North Downs Bletchingley, Southern Counties, Medivet Referrals Godstone; IVC Evidensia hospitals; Pets at Home/Vets4Pets hospitals; ~30 more CVS Vets 24/7 hospitals; large-town day clinics.
